notes.title: [Patch Preview #1] Local CO-OP and Double Jump!
notes.content:
[b]Hello community![/b]

It's been a while since the last update. Therefore we would like to show you what you can look forward to.

In the past few days we have fundamentally changed our local CO-OP mode.
In order to use the full potential of BitBattle we have changed the following things.

[h2]NEW[/h2]

You'll play now up to 4 players! Just press [Space] or "A" (Xbox Controller) to join.  

[img]https://i.ibb.co/F6PLkLk/Unbenannt.png[/img]

We also changed the old static character to a more polished one.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/MwfxbLSPJ3iu09nNS9/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611f46fdb7b113b93d01849993bd26cd38e39ae05c5&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

The game mode has been changed from rounds to a free for all system. Just like in multiplayer.

[b]And yes! there is finally the double jump![/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8i2lgomG4YTWSqUoH8/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611eadc0b01fd41e4b54b4e905910e62149964918a0&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

The core functions are ready, but we still need some time to make sure that everything works smoothly.

Due to the double jump, we have to make sure that the levels are designed in such a way that they fit the gameplay.

Stay healthy, we'll be back soon!

Cheers

notes.title: [UPDATE] Weapon and Health system Rework! Performance Update!
notes.content:
Hi there!

[b]Weapons and Health[/b]
With this update we have changed our weapons and life system.

- Players have now 100 healthpoints
- Each Weapon deals diffrent damage
- Medikit gives you 50 healthpoints 

We are still in a test phase. We are always open to improvements.

[b]Performance[/b]
We upgraded BitBattle to the newest engine version.
We have rewritten a lot of files and their call system and thus got a significantly better performance on older devices.

[b]Future[/b]
With our next update we'll bring more Maps!
Singleplayer will recieve our reworked Weapons und Health system.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: [UPDATE] BitBattle V 1.3.0!
notes.content:
BitBattlers[/b],

With patch 1.3.0 we changed a lot!

We removed the game modes "deathmatch" and "conquest".
We decided to take the two game modes out because they didn't make a big difference in the depth of the game.

[b]BUT! [/b]

Now you can play a brand new mode "Funrun"!

The rules are simple, whoever reaches the goal first wins. But traps and obstacles are waiting for you along the way!

[b]Changes[/b]:
- We changed the UI to create lobbies
- Added a "Quick find" button. Click it and you'll join a random open lobby

[b]Fixes[/b]:
- Improved networking code
- Fixed a issue which doesnt allowed you custom keybinds

notes.title: BitBattle goes V1!
notes.content:
[b]Hello BitBattle players!
[/b]
With this update we are leaving Early Access.

A lot of time has passed and we would like to thank you for all the feedback we have received over time. 
[u]THANK YOU![/u]

The update includes the following:

[b]New:[/b]
- Kill indicator (top right)
- All maps reworked (we think this style fits better to the game)
- Destruction particles for the players
- Hit feedback (visual)
- A few skins
- A few effects
- Spawn sound
- Respawn sound

[b]A few words about the maps:[/b]
We changed the style to a specific one. We think it fits better to the game. 
At the moment there are 4 maps for 2-4 players and 2 big maps for up to 8 players.

We are listening to your feedback and will add more maps when we get the chance.

[b]Technical:[/b]
We have reworked some basic network functions. It should no longer happen that players do not start at the same time.

[b]Bugs:[/b]
- Fixed the bug that after respawning the players blinked at the old position.

notes.title: BitBattle gets a big update!
notes.content:
Hi BittBattle community

Now you can play Bitbattle together with a buddy via "Remote play together"!

Main changes
- New "Dash Skill" for players
- Support up to 7 players
- Item spawner added
-- Medic kit
-- Shield
-- Bombs
-- Move speed and shoot speed
(=> You only have the bomb if you pick it up at item-spawner)
- New Maps
-- 2 big maps for 4-7 players
- All menus have been reworked

Game Mode
- Added: 
-- Conquest
-- Free for all 

In Conquest mode, you fight for flag points. 
The player who captures a point receives points for it. 
Right after death you will respawn again.

Free for all is a classic mode. The player will always respawn.

- Portal 
- New Skins (with effects)

notes.title: Day-One-Patch
notes.content:
[b]Thank you for playing BitBattle! [/b]

With this update we want to fix 2 problems.

1. The oneshoot bug should not exists anymore.
2. Now its possible to join lobbies from the main menu.

We also did some performance updates which you may not detect. But for us its a right step forward.

[b]Future plans[/b]

Our goal for one of the next updates is controller / gamepad support.
We also want to implement couch-coop. We try our best for it, but first of all we want to make sure that our multiplayer will work stable.

[i]Huge thanks from JoLu Games! [/i]
